text:
Maya: Huge congrats to @Kofi — baby Aria arrived last night! :tada: Everyone doing okay? 
Kofi: Thanks y'all! Mom and baby are doing great. We're home now — surviving on coffee and compliments. :) 
Lina: :heart: Amazing news. Want to organize a diaper cake + meal train. Is Saturday around 5pm good for a small housewarming? 
Maya: I'm in. Main dish volunteer here. Quick poll — what should we order/bring? pizza / biryani / tacos / sandwich platters — reply with your pick. 
Priya: I'll handle desserts. Also propose we do a shared 'diapers + gift card' fund. I can set up a collection. 
Devex Bot: Reminder: Please RSVP by Thu 18:00. Add your dish in thread using format: Dish - servings. 
Tara: I'll bring red lentil + kale stew (vegan) — serves ~6. 
Kofi: Y'all are the best. If anyone wants to swing by before the weekend for a quick hello, please DM — naps are precious so short visits preferred :) 
Maya: Signed up for biryani. And I'll bring some store-bought cut fruit for ease. 
Lina: Also — anyone have a foldable baby rocker or bassinet to lend for a few weeks? Kofi, DM me if you need one. 
Priya: I'll cover diapers (newborn + size 1) and wipes. Happy to coordinate pickup/dropoff. 
Devex Bot: Event created on calendar: "Kofi & Aria - Housewarming" Sat 17:00. Invite sent to attendees who RSVP. 
Maya: :sparkles: Huge congrats again, Kofi & Aria! Can't wait to celebrate (and taste Tara's stew).
